basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Bangalore, India. I spend my evenings exploring new multiplayer games on my PS5 and enjoy discussing gaming strategies with fellow Redditors. When I'm not gaming, you might find me sipping a freshly brewed cup of filter coffee while reading about the latest advancements in AI. Currently working as a software developer at a tech startup, which keeps me busy during the day. I'm in a long-distance relationship with my partner who shares my love for anime and gaming. Typically online from 6 PM to midnight IST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in software development, with a degree in Computer Science. My knowledge in gaming comes from years of playing and engaging with online communities. I'm self-taught in game strategy and mechanics, often diving deep into YouTube tutorials and Reddit discussions to enhance my skills.
